_note: Supabase Auth URL settings, applied by .github/workflows/auth-urls.yml. site_url is where Supabase sends a person when a redirect it was asked for is NOT on the allow-list. Read live on 2026-09-25 it was http://localhost:3000 with an EMPTY allow-list -- so every redirect the app ever asked for was discarded, and every emailed link (reset, confirmation, invite) opened localhost on a real person's phone. The live site is www.synapsecore.dev; the bare domain 308s to it, so both are allowed. localhost is listed explicitly: it previously worked only BY BEING the fallback, and moving the fallback without listing it would silently break local development. It is an allowed destination, never again the default one.
invite_subject: You are invited to the Synapse team
_invite_note: The invitation email for the Synapse studio team (supabase/templates/invite.html). It links straight to /app/synapse-join.html?type=invite&token_hash=..., which verifies the token itself, for the same reason the reset link does. No other part of the app sends an invite email: agency invites are links the owner copies.
_recovery_note: The reset email's body is supabase/templates/recovery.html, applied with these settings. It links to /app/signin.html?type=recovery&token_hash=..., which signin.html verifies itself. The default {{ .ConfirmationURL }} finished with a PKCE code only the requesting browser could redeem, so a reset opened on another device or in a mail app's own browser landed on a plain sign-in page (2026-09-28).
